prompt:
Image 1 is a chibi game character on a black background (Hiro in his six-star form, a plain young chibi knight (he/him): messy chestnut-brown hair with one springy cowlick tuft, big brown eyes, plain grey steel breastplate, pauldrons and greaves over brown leather, a worn dull green cloak, a plain steel longsword with four tiny dull stones in its guard; no gold, no glow). Redraw EXACTLY the same picture as a flat colour-coded PART MAP for skeletal animation: the same canvas, the same pose, size and position, every outline exactly where it is in Image 1, every region filled with one solid flat colour:
- pure BLUE #0000FF: the head: the whole face with eyes, nose and mouth, the main hair mass, hood, hat brim and crown, helmet. The face is never any other colour.
- pure WHITE #FFFFFF: torso, chest armour, shoulders, arms and hands.
- pure GREEN #00FF00: both legs from the hip down, with the boots.
- pure YELLOW #FFFF00: the held weapon or staff or shield, without the hand.
- pure RED #FF0000: long loose pieces that lie behind the body or stick out of it and move freely.
- pure CYAN #00FFFF: small loose pieces lying on top of the body.
For this character: RED: the long worn green cloak behind him, the green scarf end and the springy cowlick tuft. CYAN: the leather tassets hanging at his hips and the belt end. YELLOW: the steel longsword with its crossguard only. GREEN: both armoured legs with the boots.
Background solid pure BLACK #000000. Flat colours only: no shading, no outlines, no gradients, no text.
